// diagnostic

E1304

`parse` expects 1 argument (the argument list), got N

What

`parse` expects 1 argument (the argument list), got N

Why

`ArgsSpec.parse(args)` parses the program's words (`process.args()`) against the spec; pass exactly that list.

Fix

Pass exactly one argument: the argument list, e.g. `spec.parse(process.args())`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1304: tests/ui/args_spec_bad_parse_arity.stderr.

Error [jet.ParseArgumentCount]: `parse` expects 1 argument (the argument list), got 2
  --> tests/ui/args_spec_bad_parse_arity.jet:8:18
    |
  8 |     parsed: spec.parse(process.args(), "extra") ?? panic("parse failed")
    |                  ^^^^^
 Why: `ArgsSpec.parse(args)` parses the program's words (`process.args()`) against the spec; pass exactly that list.
 Fix: Pass exactly one argument: the argument list, e.g. `spec.parse(process.args())`
